name: Akshay Jankar
hook: Meet Akshay — the guy who sees a problem and immediately starts wondering if AI, Python, or 47 browser tabs can solve it.
paragraphs: An Electronics & Computer Science graduate who wandered deep into AI, web development, and automation, Akshay enjoys turning ambitious ideas into actual digital products. From building AI-powered applications to developing websites and intelligent systems, he's usually somewhere between writing code, debugging it, and asking AI why it broke in the first place.
He believes technology should do more than look impressive — it should make life easier, businesses smarter, and occasionally save someone from doing the same task 100 times.
superpower: Turning caffeine-free ideas into caffeine-worthy code.

name: Ankit Vishwakarma
hook: Meet Ankit — our resident security enthusiast who believes every website has a secret, and he's probably going to find it.
paragraphs: With a background in cybersecurity, web testing, and vulnerability hunting, Ankit spends his time looking for things developers hope nobody notices. From poking around websites with Burp Suite to exploring vulnerabilities, he's the guy making sure your digital doors aren't accidentally left wide open.
When he's not hunting bugs, he's probably learning something new, building something questionable, or reminding everyone that security isn't an optional feature.
superpower: Finding problems before they find you.
weakness: Probably a website that says "Access Denied."

name: Harsh Jain
hook: Meet Harsh — the guy who wants AI to run faster, locally, and without sending your data halfway across the internet.
paragraphs: A software engineer from Mumbai, Harsh is busy building things that sound like the future, from browser-native LLMs and local AI systems to real-time voice translation. By day, he's helping keep exchange-grade systems running at NSE; by night, he's shipping side projects, collecting hackathon wins, and probably testing something that shouldn't have been attempted on a weekday.
He's all about making AI smarter, faster, more private, and actually useful — without needing a cloud server for every little thing.
superpower: Making AI work without asking the cloud for permission.
weakness: One more side project. Just one. (Probably not.)
